projects.title: AI-Powered Smart Agriculture & Greenhouse System
projects.description: An IoT-enabled smart agriculture solution designed to monitor and manage greenhouse and farming operations. The system collects sensor data through ESP32-based devices, processes agricultural data, and provides analytics and AI-assisted insights to support farming decisions.
projects.role: Technical solution design, backend API development, sensor communication integration, and AI insight architecture.
keyCapabilities: IoT sensor data collection across multi-node greenhouse environments.
Agricultural telemetry data monitoring and time-series analytics.
AI-assisted predictions and crop growth health analysis.
Computer vision crop image analysis for early anomaly detection.
Automated and manual farm device monitoring and control.
Temporary offline operation with automatic data synchronization upon reconnection.

projects.title: IoT-Based Drone Building Cleaning Management
projects.description: An IoT-enabled platform supporting drone-based high-rise building cleaning operations. The platform provides building surface mapping and cleaning coverage visualization, allowing operators to monitor mission progress and understand exact facade areas covered during cleaning operations.
projects.role: Designed the IoT data ingestion pipeline, real-time telemetry processing backend, and visualization data contracts.
keyCapabilities: Architectural building facade mapping and geometric layout rendering.
Real-time cleaning coverage visual mapping and completion metrics.
Mission-related telemetry and flight session information management.
Pilot action and operational telemetry data collection.
Comprehensive telemetry collection for future optimization and analytics.
projects.operationalNote: Important accuracy note: The current drone is pilot-controlled. The system provides mapping and cleaning coverage information; it does not currently autonomously fly the drone or control its cleaning pressure. Operational data is captured to support future automation and optimization.

projects.title: Enterprise Queue Management System
projects.description: A high-availability queue management platform developed for customer-facing service centers, including bank-style establishments, mobile customer arcades, and government healthcare clinics. Customers select required services via kiosks while staff manage active queues and supervisors monitor throughput dashboards in real time.
projects.role: Led the end-to-end project lifecycle: requirements gathering, solution design, development, UAT, deployment, and post-deployment support. Collaborated directly with organizational stakeholders to define service workflows and resolve post-deployment operational issues.
keyCapabilities: Self-service customer ticket kiosk and service selection workflow.
Intelligent multi-counter queue distribution and token calling.
Service workflow management tailored to departmental needs.
Real-time administrative dashboards monitoring wait times and service rates.
Comprehensive operational reporting and SLA metrics export.

projects.title: Enterprise Workflow Management System

projects.role: Led the project lifecycle from requirements gathering and system architecture to coding, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, and stakeholder training.

Real-time workflow status monitoring and audit trails.
Department-wise performance metrics and bottleneck analysis.

projects.title: Custom HR Management System

projects.title: PeoplesHR — Enterprise HCM Platform
projects.description: An integrated, enterprise-scale Human Capital Management (HCM) platform designed to streamline workforce management processes across multinational organizations. It encompasses employee master data, global payroll, attendance, leave management, and complete employee lifecycle workflows.
projects.role: Contributed across multiple core modules: developed product enhancements, engineered client-specific change requests, resolved critical defects, and optimized query execution speeds. Collaborated with Product Owners, BAs, and QA teams across agile release cycles.
